in_sanskrit.name: उमेशा
in_sanskrit.meaning: Goddess of Pleasure, Goddess of Wine, Goddess of Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Uma + Ish + A (Uma meaning 'dark' or 'intense' and Ish meaning 'lord' or 'god', A is a suffix denoting feminine gender)

in_hindi.name: उमेशा
in_hindi.meaning: उमा (Uma) के लिए प्रभावशाली (powerful), सुखदायिनी (giver of happiness), समृद्धिप्रदायिनी (giver of prosperity)
in_hindi.long_meaning: Uma + Ish + A (Uma meaning 'dark' or 'intense' and Ish meaning 'lord' or 'god', A is a suffix denoting feminine gender)

in_tamil.name: உமேஷா
in_tamil.meaning: உமா (Uma) வழித்துவர் (goddess), சுகதேவி (goddess of happiness), பரிவர்த்தினாள் (goddess of prosperity)
in_tamil.long_meaning: Uma + Ish + A (Uma meaning 'dark' or 'intense' and Ish meaning 'lord' or 'god', A is a suffix denoting feminine gender)

in_telugu.name: ఊమేష
in_telugu.meaning: ఊదామ (Uma) ప్రభవతి (powerful), శూద్ధదేశియ (giver of happiness), సమృద్ధిప్రదేశియ (giver of prosperity)
in_telugu.long_meaning: Uma + Ish + A (Uma meaning 'dark' or 'intense' and Ish meaning 'lord' or 'god', A is a suffix denoting feminine gender)

in_marathi.name: Umesha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of rain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Umesha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of Rain and Clouds, Auspicious, Beneficent

in_bengali.name: Umesha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of rain
in_bengali.long_meaning: Umesha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess of Rain and Clouds, Auspicious, Beneficent
